en-US.author: BRIGHT ZENITH PRIVATE LIMITED
en-US.description: Agentic Coding Platform for Real Software
en-US.longDescription: Qoder is an agentic coding platform designed for real software development. It seamlessly integrates enhanced context engineering with intelligent agents to gain a comprehensive understanding of your codebase and systematically tackles software development tasks. Supports world's latest and most advanced AI models: Claude, GPT, Gemini, and more. Available for Windows and macOS.
en-US.name: Qoder IDE
en-US.releaseNotes:
Chat Tabs Now Display Running Status
Features
- Chat status at a glance: View Chat status directly in tabs to track task progress and step in when needed.
- Keyboard shortcuts for switching Chat tabs: Use keyboard shortcuts to switch between tabs to the left and right, making it easier to navigate and manage multiple tasks.
- Access the website from the IDE without signing in again: When opening website pages from the IDE, reuse your existing client sign-in state to avoid repeated authentication.
- Separate local and remote plugin installation: Plugins installed in WSL/SSH remote windows stay in the remote environment, while those installed in local windows stay locally, preventing confusion about installation locations.
- New “Open Browser” option: Open the browser with one click from the IDE’s “More Actions” menu for convenient access to external pages.
- More complete enterprise usage information: The usage panel now displays an Enterprise label and the quota refresh cycle, making it easier to understand your current plan and quota refresh schedule.
Improvements
- Improved prompts and interaction feedback when retrying failed operations. You can now switch models before retrying, and the retry will run with the newly selected model.
- Quickly click to preview .md files in the conversation stream for a better Markdown reading experience.
- Optimized code search in Auto mode to reduce unnecessary searches and improve task execution efficiency.
- Optimized the editor opening process to reduce interface lag and make opening files smoother.
- Optimized historical Chat restoration on Windows to reduce waiting time.
- Improved retry and recovery mechanisms to reduce stalled tasks after errors and enhance Agent stability.
- Improved configuration saving and synchronization reliability, reducing issues such as settings being overwritten or plugin toggle states being lost when working across multiple windows.
Fixes
- Fixed issues where sign-in state and workspace trust could be lost after a restart, and Chat history could fail to restore.
- Fixed an issue where certain environment variables caused the Chat panel to remain stuck on “Connecting”.
- Fixed an issue where the terminal repeatedly restarted automatically after failing to launch.
